verified_facts.text: Camelback Mountain is about a mile from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spend a day sightseeing on the iconic Camelback Mountain, situated just a mile away from our Scottsdale resort and spa.

verified_facts.text: The resort was designed by architect Edward Loomis Bowes.

verified_facts.text: Early guests included Mrs. Dwight D. Eisenhower, Clark Gable, Jimmy Stewart, Bette Davis and J.W. Marriott, Sr.

verified_facts.text: The accommodations are pueblo-style and pet-friendly, with kitchenettes, and a select few have private pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our pueblo-style, pet-friendly accommodations feature kitchenettes and deluxe amenities, with a select few featuring private pools.

verified_facts.text: Many of the suites have private pools and Arizona desert and mountain views.

verified_facts.text: Camelback Sun Deck Casitas have sun deck patios with views of Camelback and Mummy mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the breathtaking views of Camelback and Mummy mountains from our hotel rooms in Scottsdale, AZ, with sun deck patios

verified_facts.text: Rooms have a balcony or private patio surrounded by gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Scottsdale hotel rooms feature a balcony or private patio surrounded by lush gardens

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes hacienda-style architecture, chimineas and casita accommodations, with flowers blooming everywhere.
verified_facts.excerpt: Western themes are judiciously presented, from the hacienda style, the chimineas sending out gentle scent, and the casita accommodations

verified_facts.text: The Spa at Camelback Inn puts the desert's healing properties to use in its treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Spa at Camelback Inn puts the desert’s healing properties to good use

verified_facts.text: The spa has cabanas, and The Villa is an indoor-outdoor spa suite for small groups and special occasions.
verified_facts.excerpt: This exclusive indoor-outdoor suite provides a serene and secluded setting ideal for small groups and special occasions.

verified_facts.text: Camelback Golf Club at the resort has 36 championship holes on two courses, Ambiente and Padre.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located at our Scottsdale resort, Camelback Golf Club features 36 championship holes. Two scenic courses, Ambiente and Padre, boast native grasses, lakes, lofty trees, and mountain views.

verified_facts.text: The Padre Course was designed by golf course architect Arthur Hills.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by world-renowned golf course architect Arthur Hills, Padre Course features towering trees, subtle landforms and impressive bunkering

verified_facts.text: The Jackrabbit Pool Experience includes a children's pool, an adult pool and the Jackrabbit main pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Jackrabbit Pool Experience includes a Children's Pool, Adult Pool and Jackrabbit Main Pool.

verified_facts.text: The pool complex has private cabanas and daybeds with shade and attentive service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind in a private cabana or luxurious daybed, complete with shaded comfort and attentive service.

verified_facts.text: On-site recreation includes a play area, half-court basketball, shuffleboard, a pitch and putt course, bicycles, tennis and pickleball.
verified_facts.excerpt: a play area, half-court basketball, shuffleboard, Pitch & Putt Golf Course, bicycles, tennis, pickleball, and more

verified_facts.text: The resort has two fitness centers and private and group classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: offers two state-of-the-art fitness centers, an array of private and group classes

verified_facts.text: Rita's Cantina and Bar serves Southwestern fare and has a large stone patio with views of Mummy Mountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: The natural beauty of the land is celebrated on Rita's large stone patio. From here, views of nearby Mummy Mountain and desert flora and fauna are plentiful.

verified_facts.text: The resort's Stargazing Experience is available nightly.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grab a blanket and scope out a prime viewing spot for Camelback Inn's Stargazing Experience, available nightly!

verified_facts.text: The horticulture team leads tours on the native plants and flowers of the Sonoran Desert.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join our Horticulture team on a captivating tour where they will share fascinating insights into the diverse native plants and flowers of the Sonoran Desert.

verified_facts.text: The resort holds a 10-minute mindful activity each morning and evening.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us each morning and evening in our Scottsdale Resort for a 10-minute mindful activity.

verified_facts.text: Electric bike rentals are available daily.
verified_facts.excerpt: These powerful, easy-to-use cruiser ebikes are the perfect way to spend some time enjoying the beautiful Arizona outdoors. Available Daily

verified_facts.text: Scottsdale Fashion Square, with over 200 stores and dining choices, is an easy drive away.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience an easy drive to over 200 upscale stores and dining choices at Scottsdale Fashion Square.

verified_facts.text: Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport is about 9 miles from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: PHX is located approximately 9.0 Miles from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome, up to 2 per room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, pets are welcome at JW Marriott Scottsdale Camelback Inn Resort & Spa. Up to 2 pets are allowed per room.

verified_facts.text: The chef's gardens grow seasonal herbs, edible flowers, fruits and vegetables used in the food and beverage offerings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our chef’s gardens are planted with a bountiful variety of seasonal herbs, edible flowers, fruits and vegetables to be thoughtfully incorporated in our food and beverage offerings.
